title: integrations
subHeroTitle: Secure OAuth connections for seamless developer data flow
subHeroDesc: Native integrations with Google Workspace, GitHub, Notion, and more. Connect with your favorite tools to sync events, link code files, and build autonomous AI agents.

sections.title: Unified tool stack and secure OAuth workflows
sections.desc: Connect your developer tools natively via secure OAuth 2.0. Allow AI agents to access Google Calendar, interact with GitHub issues, import Notion pages, and sync Linear tasks.

gridItems.title: OAuth 2.0 Security Flow
gridItems.desc: All tool integrations utilize encrypted OAuth 2.0 flows, meaning KeilHQ never stores passwords or credentials.

gridItems.title: Google & GitHub Sync
gridItems.desc: Automatically link Google Workspace calendars/meetings, and let AI agents interact with GitHub repositories, PRs, and issues.

gridItems.title: Notion Content Imports
gridItems.desc: Establish OAuth token pipelines to import Notion pages, export Motion docs, and keep content bidirectionally updated.

gridItems.title: Linear & Slack Connectors
gridItems.desc: Sync Linear project boards and push workspace notification updates directly into Slack channels automatically.

sections.title: Granular notification controls and smart filters
sections.desc: Filter distraction with real-time in-app alert triggers delivered in under 50ms via WebSockets. Control exactly what alerts reach you and configure silence focus filters.

gridItems.title: Smart Alert Triggers
gridItems.desc: Receive notifications when tasks are assigned, comments are left, notes are shared, or you are mentioned.

gridItems.title: Under-50ms WebSocket Sync
gridItems.desc: A high-speed WebSocket pipeline syncs in-app alert lists across active browser tabs in under 50 milliseconds.

gridItems.title: Granular Sidebar Badges
gridItems.desc: Track pending actions with unread counts in the sidebar, cleared instantly via mark-all-read controls.

gridItems.title: Focus Silence Preferences
gridItems.desc: Define silence intervals for uninterrupted focus sessions, and configure role filters to prevent notification leaks.

capabilitiesDesc: KeilHQ integrates with your favorite tools using secure OAuth flows and API connections to create unified workflows.
checklistDesc: Stop switching between dozens of apps. Bring your entire toolkit and notifications into KeilHQ's unified interface.
checklistItems: Google Workspace single OAuth unlocks Calendar, Gmail, Drive, Docs, Sheets, Slides, and Meet integrations.,
GitHub integration enables AI agents to list issues/PRs, get details, create issues from tasks, and manage workflows.,
Notion OAuth or manual token connections for importing pages, exporting Motion docs, and bidirectional content sync.,
WebSocket alert updates: High-speed notifications syncing task assignments, comments, and mentions across tabs in under 50ms.,
Granular Silence Controls: Silence parameters and filters to configure exactly which events trigger an alert.
